title: Impact of Dietary Diversity on Postprandial Insulin Secretion and Metabolism
official: Impact of Dietary Diversity on Postprandial Insulin Secretion and Metabolism
summary: This randomized, controlled, crossover dietary intervention will test whether a three-week diverse diet, compared with a control diet with lower food diversity, changes postprandial insulin responses, other metabolic parameters, and the gut microbiome in 34 healthy adults with overweight. Participants will complete both diets in a randomized order, separated by a four-week washout period. The intervention periods will be conducted under free-living conditions, with study foods provided by the research center. Before and after each intervention period, postprandial metabolism will be assessed using standardized meal tests conducted under controlled whole-room calorimetry conditions. The primary outcome is the log-transformed total postprandial insulin area under the concentration-time curve from 0 to 240 minutes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy adults with overweight.
* Age 18-60 years.
* Body mass index (BMI) \>=25 and \<30 kg/m2.
* Men and women; the study plans an equal distribution of biological sex.
* No regular sports participation; regular sporting activity \>=2 h/week is excluded.
* German-speaking, because the study questionnaires are in German and not validated in other languages.
* No anemia or iron deficiency based on screening hemoglobin and ferritin.
* Women of childbearing potential must use hormonal contraception (e.g., pill, hormonal IUD, contraceptive patch, vaginal ring, 3-month injection, or hormonal implant) and have pregnancy excluded by hCG testing.
* Able and willing to provide written informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* \- Individuals unable to provide informed written consent.
* Vegetarian or vegan diet.
* Habitual consumption of more than 5 caffeinated beverages per day.
* Chronic diseases.
* Regular medication use, except oral contraceptives.
* Antibiotic use within 6 weeks before study start.
* Anemia and/or iron deficiency.
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
* Cigarette and/or cannabis use, including vaping.
* Food allergies and/or food intolerances.
* Current weight-reduction diet or weight loss \>5 kg within the previous 3 months.
* Regular sporting activity \>=2 h/week.
* Claustrophobia/fear of confined spaces because of EchoMRI assessment.
* Active participation in another study.
